featured_reviews.name: Gunjan Chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you think the bad reviews here are exaggerated — let me assure you, my experience tops them all. This brand is by far the worst I have ever dealt with.

The products I received were completely different from what was advertised online — wrong size, misleading color, and extremely poor quality. When I went to their store to resolve the issue, I was met with hostility and abuse multiple times instead of customer service. I was polite throughout, yet the owner falsely claimed that I had “scared” her employee — an absolutely baseless accusation, as I remained calm and respectful the entire time.

Mind you — this was the owner herself, Jankee who came down not to resolve the complaint but to further abuse, insult, and threaten me. She repeatedly tried to instigate both me and my husband to react, which of course she failed to achieve because we maintained our composure. She even went so far as to boast that she is “worth 200 crores” and that customer concerns mean nothing to her. Her exact words included, “I am not going to handle this. Call the cops or do whatever you want.” She shouted, insulted us, and even pretended to have called the police — a baseless intimidation tactic.

On top of this, they refuse to speak to customers on call and insist that refunds, returns, and exchanges are “only handled via email.” Yet, I have WhatsApp proof where they clearly told me, ‘we don’t do exchanges and returns on WhatsApp.’ If they can write that, why can’t they resolve issues directly? This only proves how inconsistent and dishonest their practices are.

Later, in clear admission of guilt, the owner blocked us from Instagram — obviously because we had proof of their wrongdoing. If she was confident in her conduct, there would be no reason to hide.

This brand refuses refunds, does not honor exchanges, and instead chooses to intimidate, abuse, and belittle customers. Such behavior is unethical, arrogant, and unlawful.

I ultimately left the defective products at the store because this is no longer about the money — it is about their abusive conduct and complete lack of business ethics. I will be escalating this matter with consumer forums and legal authorities, as no brand should be allowed to get away with deception, arrogance, and repeated abuse towards customers.

Attached are pictures clearly proving the mismatch between the sizing advertised and the products delivered.

featured_reviews.name: Gunjan Chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly horrible experience with this brand and would not recommend it to anyone.

First, the sizes mentioned on the website are completely misleading — none of the swimsuits fit me, despite following their chart. On top of that, their customer service is non-existent. I have been trying to get in touch with them over calls and emails from the very day I received my order, but there has been no proper response. The only reply I received was “these are our policies,” without even confirming whether my size is available for exchange.

Their policies themselves mention size exchanges on swimwear, but they don’t seem to honor their own commitments. They are also not picking up calls, which shows a complete lack of accountability.

As for the products:
•	One swimsuit arrived defective, with the stitching already coming off (I am attaching images).
•	Another swimsuit looks nothing like the website image — it feels like a cheap copy being passed off as “luxury.”
•	For the price (₹3,000 each), the fabric quality is terrible, far below expectations.

I even informed them that I am travelling for the next 20 days and requested to return the items immediately, but instead of resolving it, they keep hiding behind “mail communication only” and not actually addressing the issue.

This brand seems more interested in holding on to customers’ money than providing genuine service or quality. I am extremely disappointed, and I would strongly advise others to think twice before purchasing.

In response to the owner’s reply:
I want to clarify that I never made any staff member cry. I was polite throughout my visit — I even kept asking if I should sit inside or step outside with my coffee, always saying “please” and “thank you.” CCTV footage would back this up.

What’s disappointing is the contradiction — I have a written apology from the brand by email (screenshot attached) where they acknowledged my concern, yet here publicly, I’m being accused of behavior that never happened. The allegations of “harassing” staff are baseless.

As mentioned earlier, I will not withdraw from this situation — especially when the owner herself has abused me and gone as far as boasting about her “200 crores value,” making it clear she feels customers are not important. If the brand chooses to stretch this further with false accusations, I will continue to address it with facts.

& the owner is now posting reviews on my business profile to come back on me even though she has never placed an order with us

featured_reviews.review_text:
If I could give 10 ⭐️, I would! Mr. Nadeem is extremely professional and clearly takes great passion and pride in his work. From the very beginning, he was transparent with pricing, which I really appreciated.

It was my first time ordering traditional Indian clothing for a wedding (travelled all the way from Malaysia), and I wanted something versatile enough to wear again for other occasions. Truly proves what he says “if every tailor cut fabric with their brain…” 🤣🤣🤣

Highly recommended for anyone looking for honest pricing, quality craftsmanship, and beautifully tailored traditional wear.

featured_reviews.name: Suman Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I cannot express how grateful I am to Mr. Nadeem Nikhaar Ji. He is truly a lifesaver.
My outfits had been completely ruined by another tailor, and with a wedding only two weeks away, I was in a panic. Every other tailor I approached refused to take up the urgent alterations. But Mr. Nadeem Ji not only agreed to help—he took on the challenge with confidence, kindness, and absolute professionalism.
The results were beyond anything I expected. Not only were the alterations done perfectly, but he also stitched a brand-new suit for me that fits like a dream. His craftsmanship, attention to detail, and dedication to delivering quality work—especially under time pressure—are exceptional.
It’s rare to find someone so skilled, dependable, and genuinely committed to helping clients. I am extremely impressed and deeply thankful.
Highly, highly recommended. If you want impeccable tailoring and someone who truly cares about his work, go to Mr. Nadeem Nikhaar Ji. He has earned my trust for life.

featured_reviews.name: Reyna Gopal
featured_reviews.review_text:
All I can say is WOW. I found Mr Nadeem via Google Maps and I was led to one of the best tailors I’ve encountered yet. We came in with a bunch of fabrics and Mr Nadeem and his an amazing team brought these stunning outfits to life within 72 hours.

Beautiful craftsmanship with minimal adjustments. He was very transparent with the pricing from the get-go, which we truly appreciated. So if you’re looking for good quality outfits and modern designs, you gotta be prepared to pay. And quite frankly, it’s worth every rupee.

Mr Nadeem made me look the most beautiful I’ve ever felt and I couldn’t thank him enough. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

featured_reviews.name: Pavitra Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Nikhar creation is a hidden gem .thanks to my sister who discovered him  most of our family wedding collection  blouse kurtas fitting is from him . Nikhar creation became my saviour for last minute blouse done so perfectly n on time. This is my go to place now .

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Edit Review: June 28 2025

I’d written a review on them 2 months prior seeing superior work on Indian kurtas. Still feel the same that they go very good job at Indian wear, stitched about 6-7 kurtas in less than 2 months all perfect! However, few of my formal tops because have been very badly handled and the finishing piece wasn’t even close to the image I’ve shared. Of course 2-3 tops were made v well, which I did acknowledge too.

But it’s  only heart wrenching that when you put out your soul into buying fabrics they are spoilt and spoilt big time, without any sign of remorse!
When  I started sending images of how my tops were completely out of shape and size my messages were blocked and still not replied to (been over 5 -6 days) if someone claims to be true designer, taking basic ownership as a professional is crucial instead of giving lame excuses of fabric being stretchy etc. We consider designers for a reason, that they would deliver what we seek.  For a basic black skirt, I simply asked for elastic and no hooks on the waist , I got exactly the opposite two hoops and zero elastic, with the skirt almost hanging below my belly button, inspite of giving my measurements properly just 2-3 days before delivery. I generally would never write a bad review but not accepting mistakes and blocking my texts and not responding is very very disappointing and unprofessional

featured_reviews.name: Marina Nicole Czarnecki
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome place!! Came to him and he made custom blouses for me and my friends for a wedding in 1 day. Brought him my saree and he found material for a perfect blouse match. And he is so kind to talk to. Highly recommend!

I would like to share a very bad experience with the Fabindia recently !!
On 10th Dec I bought bath towels and hand towels from Fabindia Khar West branch worth INR 6,000 plus.
When I washed the towels on 13th Dec in the washing machine on delicate mode, some of the towels gave a lot of lint which got stuck onto all the towels.
On advice of the manager at the branch and after showing her the state of the towels, we wrote an email to Fabindia to make an official complaint.
After constant follow up and after another 5 emails, they agreed to exchange only 2 towels - one big and one hand towel worth only INR 1,500 - in exchange for a credit note to be used within 90 days only.
This was when I had the payment receipt and the tags on the towels all with me as a proof.
I feel Fabindia needs to give their customers better after sales service !!
